comment: Room feel tuning, re-read on every Room load. The Room panel edits it live without saving. Times are seconds, distances metres, angles degrees. The dash cooldown starts when the dash ends. Targeting: the ray picks the cell ray_length ahead; failing that, the nearest workable thing within cone_range and cone_half_angle of facing. The Target pulses brighten_rate times a second, blending up to brighten_strength (0-1) toward the Operator's colour lightened brighten_lift (0-1) toward white. The Antenna Coupler keeps every Radio dark for coupler_reset s after it disconnects (keep it under 0.5). A set-down puffs dust_puff.count particles off the Counter at speed m/s, each starting size m in radius and living lifetime s, fanned spread (0 is a column) from straight up.
